test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He __burnt his fingers__ by getting into others’ problems.
solution:
The correct answer is "To get into trouble".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given underlined words are a **phrase**.
 
• The phrase **"****burnt his fingers__****"** means **"get someone into trouble"**.
 
• Here the sentence means he got into problems by interfering in other's problems.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **"To get rid off"** means to be free from something.
 
• The meaning of **"****To get rewarded"** is something that is presented or given in exchange for a service or achievement, or as recompense for good deeds or bad deeds received.
 
• To give fire in one's finger is the meaning of the last option.
 
• All those meanings are not **appropriate** or suitable for the given question.
